title: Retrying a failed async job steals the record from its original owners
author: NamanSoni78

gist.summary: Fixed async job ownership for identical requests: when another account retries a failed job, the shared record keeps every previous submitter in ownerIds instead of replacing them with the retrying account. Original submitters can continue polling /v1/jobs/:id and read the latest run's status rather than getting a premature 404. A regression test covers a failed image job retried by another account and checks that only the retrying account is charged for the new run.
